Renny carries the heaviest week at 20.5 hrs, driven by the 7h [BLOCK] Prudential Site Recce pt 2 on Wed — open question whether that block should count as a meeting (it currently does, per the locked rules).
■ Focus time — first flagging run, covering Wed 11 Nov onwards. Two flags: (1) Wed 11 Nov 14:00, [INT] Garrett MY Threads Regroup (30 min) — Natalie and Stephanie pulling Beverly and Cher into the 12:30pm+ focus window. (2) Wed 11 Nov 10:00–17:00, [BLOCK] Prudential Site Recce pt 2 — Sheryl with Renny, a 7h block covering the whole focus window; it is the microdrama shoot recce, so say if that counts as shoot work and should be exempt. #whatstrending Thu 12:00–12:30 ends at 12:30, so it is not a flag. No other flags Thu–Fri.
■ Capitol Shoot: still no Capitol shoot on any team calendar this week (Luckin Thu, DTG Fri only) — the Fri 6 Nov Capitol shoot never reappeared. Please confirm what happened — I have not changed any calendar entry.
■ Benelic. Media-drop art re-dated to Tue 10 Nov 12:00 (Renny, Bernetta). New this week: [INT] Benelic Regroup Tue 10 Nov 12:00 (6 people) and [TBC] Benelic Chat with Client Tue 15:00 (5 people). Launch Wed 2 Dec — tight runway.
■ Monday: 7 tasks due this week still open (new week, so not comparable with last week’s 16), 0 due today (Mon), 7 rest of week (Tue–Sun). 5 due Tue — Benelic media-drop art (Renny, Bernetta), CJ’s CHIJMES Christmas Markets AD, Bernetta’s Garrett Inside Out art, Sherman’s SKM reel PROD; 1 Wed — Cher’s Benelic Media/KOLs planner; 1 Thu — Sue’s Benelic Media/KOLs intern. Two of the six were Done with blank hours (Rachel’s animation, Riduwan’s producer subtask) — hours not recorded.

Done with blank hours, deadline in week: 0. OT = exceeding 6 productive hours in a day — cannot be calculated reliably while hours are blank for most due tasks.
